sentences.cs: Když jsme se s Klárou rozhodli bydlet spolu, mysleli jsme, že najít byt bude snadné.
sentences.en: When Klára and I decided to live together, we thought finding a flat would be easy.

sentences.cs: Mýlili jsme se.
sentences.en: We were wrong.

sentences.cs: Praha je město, kde je nájem vysoký a bytů málo.
sentences.en: Prague is a city where the rent is high and flats are few.

sentences.cs: Každý večer jsme prohlíželi inzeráty na internetu.
sentences.en: Every evening we went through the adverts on the internet.

sentences.cs: Většina z nich byla stará několik dní a už neplatila.
sentences.en: Most of them were several days old and no longer valid.

sentences.cs: Když jsme někam zavolali, majitel často řekl, že byt je už zamluvený.
sentences.en: When we called somewhere, the owner often said the flat was already reserved.

sentences.cs: Jednou jsme přijeli na prohlídku a před domem stálo dvacet dalších lidí.
sentences.en: Once we arrived for a viewing and twenty other people were standing in front of the building.

sentences.cs: Byt měl dvě místnosti, malou kuchyň a okna do dvora.
sentences.en: The flat had two rooms, a small kitchen and windows onto the courtyard.

sentences.cs: Světlo tam skoro nebylo, ale stejně by ho někdo hned vzal.
sentences.en: There was almost no light, but someone would have taken it straight away anyway.

sentences.cs: Klára řekla, že by tam nechtěla bydlet ani zadarmo.
sentences.en: Klára said she would not want to live there even for free.

sentences.cs: Hledali jsme dál, i když nás to už unavovalo.
sentences.en: We kept looking, even though it was wearing us out.

sentences.cs: Kdybychom měli víc peněz, vybírali bychom si.
sentences.en: If we had more money, we would be picky.

sentences.cs: Takhle jsme brali, co bylo.
sentences.en: As it was, we took what there was.

sentences.cs: Nakonec nám pomohla náhoda.
sentences.en: In the end chance helped us.

sentences.cs: Kolega z práce se stěhoval do Berlína a hledal někoho, kdo by si vzal jeho byt.
sentences.en: A colleague from work was moving to Berlin and was looking for someone who would take over his flat.

sentences.cs: Nebyl velký, ale byl světlý a klidný.
sentences.en: It was not big, but it was light and quiet.

sentences.cs: Byl ve starém domě, ve třetím patře, bez výtahu.
sentences.en: It was in an old building, on the third floor, without a lift.

sentences.cs: Nájem byl vyšší, než jsme chtěli platit, ale rozhodli jsme se rychle.
sentences.en: The rent was higher than we wanted to pay, but we decided quickly.

sentences.cs: Podepsali jsme smlouvu na dva roky.
sentences.en: We signed a two-year contract.

sentences.cs: Stěhovali jsme se v sobotu a pršelo celý den.
sentences.en: We moved on Saturday and it rained all day.

sentences.cs: Kamarádi nám pomohli nosit krabice do třetího patra.
sentences.en: Friends helped us carry boxes up to the third floor.

sentences.cs: Večer jsme seděli mezi krabicemi a jedli pizzu z papíru.
sentences.en: In the evening we sat among the boxes and ate pizza off the paper.

sentences.cs: Nábytek jsme skládali ještě další týden.
sentences.en: We were still assembling the furniture a week later.

sentences.cs: Teď, když se ráno probudím, slyším z ulice tramvaj.
sentences.en: Now, when I wake up in the morning, I hear a tram from the street.

sentences.cs: Kdybych si měl vybrat znovu, vybral bych si ten samý byt.
sentences.en: If I had to choose again, I would choose the same flat.
